text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — opened a small docs PR to add a focused 'tiered usage' playbook for rate limits + quota UX. PR has: short migration notes, a tiny SDK example for header-based metering, and a dashboard panel link. asking for a quick review before i merge. https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4123

jordan: on it. can you paste the SDK snippet inline here? want to sanity-check the headers and backoff guidance.

olivia: sure — copied from the draft PR:```python
# python SDK snippet showing quota header
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate("tell me a haiku", headers={"X-Usage-Tier": "tier:pro", "X-Quota-Trace": "migration-2026"})
print(resp.text)
```

priya: looks good. a couple of notes: 1) call out that X-Usage-Tier is advisory for routing only (doesn't override enforced limits). 2) add a short example for burst credits + ramping when quota hits a ceiling.

kevin: for the burst example, maybe show a small retry/backoff snippet. e.g.:```bash
# curl with retry header hint
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Usage-Tier: tier:pro" -d '{"prompt":"..."}' 
# if 429, use exponential backoff and honor Retry-After
```

olivia: good call. i'll add both a short bash retry pattern and a node snippet. also adding an explicit sentence under 'Behavior' that enforced quotas supersede advisory headers.

docs-bot: PR 4123 opened by olivia — reviewers requested: @jordan @priya. CI: docs-lint passed, link-check pending.

jordan: tiny nit — the dashboard link in the PR points to the old panel id. the new panel URL is https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/usage?panelId=7 — pls swap. the panel query should show per-tier token consumption over 1h and 24h.

olivia: swapping now. panel query in the draft:```promql
sum by(tier) (increase(redwood_api_tokens_total{tier!=""}[1h]))
```
I'll add a 24h variant and a short caption explaining we recommend 1h for burst detection, 24h for trend.

priya: also add a short 'migration checklist' at the top: 1) update SDK header example 2) add dashboard link 3) notify SRE about expected spike during migration 4) add redirects from old docs URL. keeps reviewers focused.

kevin: FYI from infra — if customers use advisory headers at scale we may need to add sampling metadata to the metrics (we have a ticket). might be worth a one-line callout in the playbook that metrics could be sampled until infra change.

olivia: noted, will add that callout and link the infra ticket. final ask: can you both review the wording around "metering semantics"? i want it short and non-legal.

jordan: i skimmed — i think "advisory routing header; does not change enforced quota" is clear enough. priya?

priya: that wording works. +1 from me once the dashboard link + retry snippet are in.

olivia: thanks — updating now, will request final review in PR. merging after approvals. :thumbsup:
